replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. Finally, form a matrix from the top k eigenvectors and transform the original data onto the new subspace. The mathematics can be complex, but there are many tools and software that can help you perform PCA without getting too anxious about the underlying math.
